subject: President Volodymyr Zelensky, appearing to tell Ukrainian troops to surrender
claim: A video of Zelensky at a podium urging soldiers to lay down their arms spread after hackers pushed it onto the Ukraine 24 TV website and news ticker. Ukraine said it was fake.
finding: It was a crude deepfake: a mismatched face and voice placed onto a body. Ukrainian officials had warned weeks earlier that such a video might appear.
outcome: Zelensky quickly posted his own video rebutting it. Meta removed the deepfake. It had little effect.

sources.title: Deepfake video of Zelenskyy could be 'tip of the iceberg' in info war, experts warn
